description: List enrollments within a specific course with Canvas filters. Use `include=grades` / `include=current_points` for richer grade data, `type[]` to limit to a role, and `user_id` to focus on a single user.

enrollment_term_id.description: Limit to enrollments in the given term

grading_period_id.description: Scope grade-related includes to this grading period

include.description: Extra fields to include (Canvas include[] param)

type.description: Filter by one or more enrollment types

user_id.description: Filter to a specific user. Canvas ID (pass large IDs as a string) or "self".
